source_evidence.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Compute the sum of the column norms. Exact assumptions and formula below.
source_evidence.statement: At every ambient vector x, the squared column norms of I−xxᵀ sum to d−2‖x‖²+‖x‖⁴, where d is the number of coordinates.
assumptions: I is a finite coordinate type with decidable equality. The space is real Euclidean space on I.
Write e_j for the j-th coordinate vector and σ_j(x)=e_j−x_j x.
The vector x is arbitrary, and the sum runs over every coordinate.
source_evidence.boundary: At a unit vector the squared column norm sum is d−1.
